name: How do I choose between an L-shaped and a U-shaped kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between an L-shaped and a U-shaped kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: An L-shaped layout fits open floor plans and smaller spaces, whereas a U-shaped layout provides maximum continuous counter space and storage in dedicated rooms. An L-shaped footprint keeps two walls open, making it simple to incorporate an island and integrate the kitchen with an adjoining living area. A U-shaped footprint wraps around three walls, which isolates the work area from foot traffic but may make multiple cooks feel confined if the central floor space is narrow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose an L-shape if you want an open feel with room for an island; choose a U-shape if you prioritize continuous countertop space and enclosed storage.
